summary: This clinical trial tested different doses of a drug called aleniglipron to help adults who are living with obesity or overweight and a weight-related health condition. The study had 230 participants and compared the drug against an inactive substance called a placebo. This research is identified by the clinical trial number NCT06693843. The study status is Completed, meaning the trial has finished.
